text: Ko Alla Tagi kala ko woni ladude ka hoore leydi e mummunteeji ɗin immorde e toɓɓere [maniiyu], no e majji ɗin yaarooji reedu muuɗum e daasagol wano mbolle ɗen, no e majji ɗin yaarooji kayɗe ɗiɗi wano neɗɗo on e sonndu ndun, no e majji kadi ɗin yaarooji [koyɗe] nayi wano neemoraaɗi ɗin, Alla hiMo Taga ko O Muuyi ko O jaŋtii kon e ko O jaŋtaaki kon kadi, pellet, Alla ko O hattanɗo e dow kala huunde, hay e huunde ronkintah Mo.
